Hi Pree. I found three ticket numbers tied to Marrow Fieldworks, with one caveat on the first two.

1. **PD-5302**: Hollis Mbeki posted it in #central-random on 14 Oct (09:00 UTC) as a follow-up from this week. It is the only one that names Marrow Fieldworks directly.
2. **#4409** and **3. #4412**: Moss's public handoff digest, "Moss: Central handoffs next week" (`teams/team-central/digests/2026-01-02-central-handoffs.md`, dated 2 Jan 2026). The digest lists both under "Pre-handoff items" right after its Marrow Fieldworks handoff bullet. It describes them as open tickets on "Pree's dealer account" and never names Marrow Fieldworks on them, so please confirm they belong to Marrow Fieldworks before you rely on them. #4409 is a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at Salina North. #4412 is a driver SMS prompt glitch on overflow lots.

I also checked GBrain, which returned the same January digest. Its search is keyword-only, so it may have missed other matches. I found no Marrow Fieldworks tickets in Moss's North digests, in this week's #central-team messages, or in #central-random beyond PD-5302.

I left out a few ticket numbers that look close but are not Marrow Fieldworks: PD-4821 (Marrow Agrisupply), FR-882 (Marrow Agrisupply), #8841 (Tobias's dealer account), and #88412 (Tansleigh Packaging).
